simFastBOIN: Fast Simulation of Bayesian Optimal Interval Designs

Source: R/simFastBOIN-package.R
simFastBOIN-package.Rd

Tools for designing and evaluating phase I dose-finding trials that use the Bayesian optimal interval (BOIN) design of Liu and Yuan (2015). The simulation engine is written in C++ and reproduces the reference implementation in the BOIN package exactly, including the order in which random variates are consumed, so that results obtained with the same seed agree to the last trial.

Design tools

boin_lambda

Escalation and de-escalation interval boundaries.

boin_p_tox

The toxic threshold giving a required de-escalation boundary.

boin_boundary

Integer decision boundaries as a function of sample size.

boin_decision_table

Decision table indexed by DLTs and patients, with print and plot methods.

boin_stopping_table

Safety stopping boundary as a two-row table.

tite_boin_decision_table

Decision table of the time-to-event BOIN design, which treats new patients while earlier DLT data are pending, with print and plot methods.

Simulation tools

sim_boin

Operating characteristics for one scenario.

sim_boin_multi

Operating characteristics for several scenarios.

boin_simulate

Raw trial data from the simulation engine.

boin_isotonic

Isotonic estimates of the DLT probability.

boin_select_mtd

MTD selection from completed trials.

sim_tite_boin

Operating characteristics of the time-to-event BOIN design for one scenario, with trial duration and suspensions of accrual.

sim_tite_boin_multi

The same for several scenarios.

tite_boin_simulate

Raw trial data from the time-to-event BOIN engine, with patients arriving over time and DLTs observed late.

Backfilling

sim_bf_boin

Operating characteristics of the BOIN design with backfilling (BF-BOIN) for one scenario of DLT and response probabilities.

sim_bf_boin_multi

The same for several scenarios.

bf_boin_simulate

Raw trial data from the BF-BOIN engine, with backfilled patients and responses.

sim_be_boin

Operating characteristics of BE-BOIN, which combines backfilling with the time-to-event BOIN design, for one scenario.

sim_be_boin_multi

The same for several scenarios.

be_boin_simulate

Raw trial data from the BE-BOIN engine.

Drug combinations

sim_comb_boin

Operating characteristics of the BOIN drug-combination design of Lin and Yin (2017) for one matrix of DLT probabilities.

sim_comb_boin_multi

The same for several matrices.

comb_boin_simulate

Raw trial data from the drug-combination engine.

comb_boin_select_mtd

Selection of the MTD combination from completed trials.

comb_boin_next

The combination for the next cohort of a trial in progress, with print and plot methods.

sim_waterfall

Operating characteristics of the waterfall design of Zhang and Yuan (2016), which finds the MTD contour, for one matrix of DLT probabilities.

sim_waterfall_multi

The same for several matrices.

waterfall_simulate

Raw trial data from the waterfall engine.

waterfall_select_mtd

Selection of the MTD contour from completed trials.

Optimal biological dose (BOIN-ET)

boin_et_boundary

Boundaries of the BOIN-ET design of Takeda, Taguri and Morita (2018), which decides from both the DLT and the response.

boin_et_decision_table

Decision table indexed by DLTs and responses, with a print method.

sim_boin_et

Operating characteristics of BOIN-ET for one scenario of DLT and response probabilities, with the selection of the optimal biological dose (OBD).

sim_boin_et_multi

The same for several scenarios.

boin_et_simulate

Raw trial data from the BOIN-ET engine.

boin_et_select_obd

Selection of the OBD from completed trials, with the estimators and selection rules of the 'boinet' package.

sim_tite_boin_et

Operating characteristics of the time-to-event TITE-BOIN-ET design of Takeda, Morita and Taguri (2020).

sim_tite_boin_et_multi

The same for several scenarios.

tite_boin_et_simulate

Raw trial data from the TITE-BOIN-ET engine.

sim_bf_boin_et

Operating characteristics of the backfill BF-BOIN-ET design of Takeda, Zhu and Hirakawa (2025).

sim_bf_boin_et_multi

The same for several scenarios.

Optimal biological dose (BOIN12 and TITE-BOIN12)

boin12_decision_table

Desirability scores of the BOIN12 design of Lin et al. (2020), indexed by patients, DLTs and responses.

sim_boin12

Operating characteristics of BOIN12 for one scenario of DLT and response probabilities, with the selection of the OBD.

sim_boin12_multi

The same for several scenarios.

boin12_simulate

Raw trial data from the BOIN12 engine.

boin12_select_obd

OBD selection from completed trials.

sim_tite_boin12

Operating characteristics of the time-to-event TITE-BOIN12 design of Zhou et al. (2022).

sim_tite_boin12_multi

The same for several scenarios.

tite_boin12_simulate

Raw trial data from the TITE-BOIN12 engine.

Optimal biological dose (U-BOIN)

uboin_utility_table

Posterior mean utility and admissibility of a dose for every outcome of its patients, the decision tables of the U-BOIN design of Zhou, Lee and Yuan (2019).

sim_uboin

Operating characteristics of U-BOIN for one scenario of DLT and response probabilities, with the selection of the OBD.

sim_uboin_multi

The same for several scenarios.

uboin_simulate

Raw trial data from the U-BOIN engine.

uboin_select_obd

OBD selection from completed trials.

The 3+3 design

oc_3p3

Operating characteristics of the traditional 3+3 design, in closed form.

sim_3p3

The same design by simulation, as a check on the closed form.

decision_table_3p3

Decision table of the 3+3 design, with print and plot methods.

Tables and figures

oc_scenarios

True scenarios with the utilities and the true MTDs and OBDs, with print and plot methods.

oc_results

Results of several designs in one long table, with print and plot methods.

oc_compare

Several designs judged against the true doses, with print and plot methods.

References

Liu S. and Yuan, Y. (2015). Bayesian Optimal Interval Designs for Phase I Clinical Trials. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series C, 64, 507-523.

Yan, F., Zhang, L., Zhou, Y., Pan, H., Liu, S. and Yuan, Y. (2020). BOIN: An R Package for Designing Single-Agent and Drug-Combination Dose-Finding Trials Using Bayesian Optimal Interval Designs. Journal of Statistical Software, 94(13), 1-32.

Yuan, Y., Lin, R., Li, D., Nie, L. and Warren, K. E. (2018). Time-to-Event Bayesian Optimal Interval Design to Accelerate Phase I Trials. Clinical Cancer Research, 24(20), 4921-4930.

Lin, R. and Yuan, Y. (2020). Time-to-Event Model-Assisted Designs for Dose-Finding Trials with Delayed Toxicity. Biostatistics, 21(4), 807-824.

Zhao, Y., Yuan, Y., Korn, E. L. and Freidlin, B. (2024). Backfilling Patients in Phase I Dose-Escalation Trials Using Bayesian Optimal Interval Design (BOIN). Clinical Cancer Research, 30(4), 673-679.

Chen, K., Zhao, Y., Takeda, K. and Yuan, Y. (2026). BE-BOIN: A Dose Optimization Design Accommodating Backfill and Late-Onset Toxicity. Therapeutic Innovation and Regulatory Science. doi:10.1007/s43441-026-00994-0

Lin, R. and Yin, G. (2017). Bayesian Optimal Interval Design for Dose Finding in Drug-Combination Trials. Statistical Methods in Medical Research, 26(5), 2155-2167.

Takeda, K., Taguri, M. and Morita, S. (2018). BOIN-ET: Bayesian optimal interval design for dose finding based on both efficacy and toxicity outcomes. Pharmaceutical Statistics, 17(4), 383-395. doi:10.1002/pst.1864

Takeda, K., Morita, S. and Taguri, M. (2020). TITE-BOIN-ET: Time-to-event Bayesian optimal interval design to accelerate dose-finding based on both efficacy and toxicity outcomes. Pharmaceutical Statistics, 19, 335-349. doi:10.1002/pst.1995

Takeda, K., Zhu, J. and Hirakawa, A. (2025). BF-BOIN-ET: A backfill Bayesian optimal interval design using efficacy and toxicity outcomes for dose optimization. Pharmaceutical Statistics, 24, e2470. doi:10.1002/pst.2470

Lin, R., Zhou, Y., Yan, F., Li, D. and Yuan, Y. (2020). BOIN12: Bayesian optimal interval phase I/II trial design for utility-based dose finding in immunotherapy and targeted therapies. JCO Precision Oncology, 4, 1393-1402. doi:10.1200/PO.20.00257

Zhou, Y., Lin, R., Lee, J. J., Li, D., Wang, L., Li, R. and Yuan, Y. (2022). TITE-BOIN12: A Bayesian phase I/II trial design to find the optimal biological dose with late-onset toxicity and efficacy. Statistics in Medicine, 41(11), 1918-1931. doi:10.1002/sim.9337
